title: New-Site Endpoint Rollout Playbook
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (repeatable rollout program coordinating provisioning, baseline, apps, printing, and validation for a new location).
hook: Open a new office, clinic, or site with endpoints that work on day one
problem: Standing up endpoints at a new location — a new clinic, branch, or acquired office — usually means reinventing the rollout each time, scrambling on go-live day, and discovering missing apps, printers, or network access when staff are already trying to work. This solution is a repeatable new-site endpoint rollout playbook: a sequenced program that provisions devices, applies your baseline, installs the site's apps and printers, validates connectivity and identity, and runs a go-live checklist — so every new site opens the same proven way.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the new-site rollout model, the dependency order (network/identity → provisioning → baseline → apps/printers → validation → go-live), and how it reuses your existing Intune standards.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, the site's network/identity readiness, your device baseline, the site app/printer set, a go-live window) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: confirm network/identity, build the site device group, provision devices, apply baseline, deploy site apps and printers, validate connectivity/identity/printing, run the go-live checklist, then expand to the next site.
5 PowerShell scripts — site-readiness discovery, per-device go-live validation, a site rollout status report, safe remediation of failed deployments, and a site device-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable new-site endpoint rollout playbook — a sequenced program that provisions devices, applies your baseline, deploys site apps and printers, validates, and runs a go-live checklist, so every new location opens the same proven way. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A repeatable new-site endpoint rollout playbook — provision devices, apply your baseline, deploy site apps and printers, validate, and run a go-live checklist so every new location opens the same way.
meta_description: Roll out endpoints at a new office, clinic, or site: sequenced provisioning, baseline, site apps and printers, connectivity/identity validation, and a go-live checklist. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Every new site opening with endpoints that work on day one — provisioned, baselined, app- and printer-ready, and validated against a go-live checklist — proven on a pilot site before you repeat it everywhere.

hero.tagline: OPEN ANY SITE.  THE SAME PROVEN WAY.
